title: text delete

messages.description: line number to delete (negative deletes all text)
pointer to the text if -s flag is used

arguments.description: array name if no flags are given

flags.name: -s <symbol, symbol>
flags.description: struct name and field name of main structure

body: [text delete] deletes a line of a text, given its number (0 for the first); a negative number deletes all lines. The text is named by the argument or the right inlet, or found through a pointer with -s.
